name: ai-sdlc-4-validate
goal: Verify that the repository is release-ready. Focus on checking existing artifacts, not writing new ones.
fast_track: Run planned checks; record results, omitted checks with reasons, and phase 4. Skip the release-readiness checklist; do not claim full release readiness. Required CI/review still apply.

steps.detail: Run the project-specific unit and integration test commands from docs/PROJECT.md; verify both pass.
Check tests/e2e/; extend existing tests if needed; create only if none exist.
Check Dockerfile builds and starts the application; create only if missing.
CI and release run scripts/test.sh when it exists; create or update it to run the unit and integration test commands from docs/PROJECT.md. Do not add a separate test workflow.
Check .github/workflows/release.yml builds the container, runs e2e tests, publishes the artifact; create only if missing.

rules: Prefer verifying and extending existing artifacts.
Create files only if they do not exist.
output: Unit and integration tests pass; repository verified.
record_in: docs/TASKS.md; actual evidence also in the active UC file's Evidence section, so it stays with the use case
